title: Signature Calm Scope Suite
concept: Endoscopy suites with nature murals, warm blankets, and unhurried sedation — the procedure, de-feared. Calm scopes, better exams. Concept by Manon.
improvement_over_conventional: Improves on cold procedure rooms with a calming suite.
patient_flow: Referrals come for bleeding, pain, screening, or abnormal labs; prep instructions go out days ahead for colonoscopies. Procedure days run like clockwork — sedation, scope, biopsies, recovery — with pathology follow-up. Chronic patients (IBD, liver disease) cycle through longitudinal clinics with infusions, monitoring, and nutrition support.
code_demo:
# Signature Calm Scope Suite — Signature design prototype
def colonoscopy_due(age, last_result, years_since):
    """Simplified colonoscopy screening scheduler (average risk)."""
    if age < 45: return "Routine screening starts at 45"
    interval = 10 if last_result == "normal" else 5 if last_result == "small polyps" else 3
    due = interval - years_since
    return f"Next colonoscopy in {max(due,0)} years ({'DUE NOW' if due <= 0 else 'on schedule'})"
print(colonoscopy_due(52, "small polyps", 4))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
